|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ミレニアム・ファルコンをタトゥイーンから追跡した帝国軍艦艇の1隻。光速に突入する直前のファルコンをスキャンした。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Conquest.

'''Card text:'''
May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. After declaring battle against Falcon, you may look at the Rebel hand.

'''Lore:'''
One of the Imperial ships that chased the Millennium Falcon from Tatooine. It scanned the Falcon just before it jumped to lightspeed.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese looks at the Rebel hand after declaring battle against Falcon.
